$comment: CODM capture plan (T1). Items still missing after G1 (P2a gate, 2026-10-27, docs/evidence/2026-10-27-p2a-gate.md §2). Not a blocker: the W1 coverage tracker (services/clip/coverage.py) collects each item whenever it happens in normal play or on stream and reports when it is captured; its state is local (data/games/codm/local/coverage.json, gitignored) and this file is never edited at runtime. `match` says how an item is recognised, using only existing detector, screen and medal definitions: auto items are captured by the first detection that meets a criterion; manual items have no measured cue for an automatic decision, so detections are only candidates and the user confirms with `coverage.py mark`. Ask the user for a dedicated capture only for items still missing at the W3 evaluation. Schema: ../capture-plan.schema.json; cross-file checks: tools/game-validate.mjs. DMZ is out of scope (tag-only mode) and is not listed.

match.reason: Only the waiting line has measured positions (N2 revival_top, revival); no cue exists for the redeploy that completes a revival. Waiting-line detections are candidates.

match.reason: No BR end-screen detector exists (M1 runs in MP only) and the br_placement cue (GAME OVER) is unverified with no position; the #1 placement is not read. The user marks it.
